name: Hytale-broccoli
description: A dedicated server for Hytale. The server files are downloaded and updated with the official Hytale Downloader. First start: you must sign in with your Hytale account. Open the container log, go to the URL that it shows, and sign in. When the server has started, the log shows a second link. Open it and authorize again. View distance has the largest effect on RAM use. Set MAX_MEMORY to match the RAM you give the server. Hytale uses QUIC over UDP. Forward UDP port 5520 on your router. If you change the port, also change DEFAULT_PORT. To install mods, put .jar or .zip files in the mods folder of the server files and restart the container. Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.

paths.name: Server Files
paths.description: Server files, worlds, mods, config, backups, and saved authentication.

ports.name: Game Port
ports.description: UDP game port (QUIC). Forward it on your router. Must be the same as DEFAULT_PORT.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name of the server.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players on the server.

variables.name: View Distance
variables.description: View distance in chunks. 12 chunks is 384 blocks. Higher values need more RAM.

variables.name: Max Memory
variables.description: Maximum Java heap size, for example 8G or 8192M. Include the unit.

variables.name: Enable Backups
variables.description: Make automatic world backups (true or false).

variables.name: Backup Frequency
variables.description: Minutes between backups, when backups are on.

variables.name: Backup Max Count
variables.description: Number of backups to keep.

variables.name: Min Memory
variables.description: Minimum Java heap size, for example 4G. Leave empty to not set a minimum.

variables.name: JVM Arguments
variables.description: Optional extra Java arguments, for example -XX:+UseG1GC.

variables.name: Auth Mode
variables.description: authenticated or offline. Use offline only for testing, because it lets players join without authentication.

variables.name: Auth Select Profile
variables.description: Profile number to authenticate the server with, if your account has more than one profile.

variables.name: Patchline
variables.description: Game patchline: release or pre-release.

variables.name: Download On Start
variables.description: Download and update the server files on each start. Set to false to skip.

variables.name: Default Port
variables.description: UDP port the server listens on. Must be the same as the Game Port.

variables.name: Backup Directory
variables.description: Folder in the container for backups. Keep it inside /home/hytale/server-files so backups persist.

variables.name: Use AOT Cache
variables.description: Use the ahead-of-time compilation cache for a faster start.

variables.name: Accept Early Plugins
variables.description: Allow early plugins. These can make the server unstable.

variables.name: Disable Sentry
variables.description: Turn off Sentry crash reporting.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions.
